public_rationale: The statement is a hedged expectation, not a categorical prediction with a defined period. Continued operations or ordinary bank lending would not prove it right, and a single adverse outcome would not fairly disprove an unspecified probability. Scoring it requires adding commitments the speaker did not make.
limitations: This does not assess whether the expectation is financially plausible.
Existing lending relationships cannot be treated as promises of unlimited rescue funding.
